name: aca-oh
title: Ohio individual health plans, plan year 2026
summary: Read Ohio's 2026 individual health plan data from CMS's public use files: rates, tobacco loads, age curves, plan attributes, cost sharing and checks of the data itself.
description: Each task gives the AI extracts of CMS's public use files for Ohio's individual health insurance market and states its facts in the question, such as an age and a rating area. It asks for exact answers: a monthly rate, a tobacco load, a ratio, a deductible, a count, a list of plans, or a finding in the data itself. Every field of the answer is checked, and a task passes only when all of them are right. Plan IDs, counts and lists must match exactly.

families.name: Rate lookup
families.what: The monthly rate of the right plan, rating area and age band, among look-alike plan IDs and variants.

families.name: Household total
families.what: A household's total as the sum of each person's listed rate, with a tobacco user or plans of the same name.

families.name: Tobacco load
families.what: Tobacco loads that change with age, read at the right ages and for the right plans and issuers.

families.name: Age curve
families.what: Ratios to age 21 and rating area factors read from the rates, for medical and dental plans.

families.name: Plan attributes
families.what: Metal levels, plan types and HSA eligibility, told apart across look-alike plans and variants.

families.name: Cost sharing
families.what: Deductibles, out-of-pocket maximums and coinsurance of the right cost-sharing variant.

families.name: Joined files
families.what: Rates joined to plan attributes without counting a plan once per variant.

families.name: Counts
families.what: How many issuers, plans and rows there are, counted at the right level.

families.name: Checking the data
families.what: Real oddities in the data, told apart from figures that only look wrong.
